entries.e4e92734187cc8e4: This business develops, manufactures and sells precious metal plating chemicals used on contact and connection points of electronic components such as printed circuit boards (including package substrates), connectors and lead frames. The company is a single segment, the Precious Metal Plating Chemicals Manufacturing Business, so segment information is omitted. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements and has no affiliated companies. The head office and head office plant are located in Nerima Ward, Tokyo, and the company opened the Masuma Office in fiscal 2025. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 60. Manufacturing centers on formulation, in which purchased precious metal ingots and chemicals are blended according to in-house recipes, and the company does not own large-scale manufacturing equipment.
